relationships.subject: CGRP 8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP 8-37 (1 μM, 20 min) significantly decreased calcium transients in CeA-CRF neurons

relationships.subject: CGRP 8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP 8-37 administration significantly increased the hindlimb withdrawal thresholds in both male (n = 12, P < 0.001) and female (n = 24, P < 0.0001) SNL rats compared to ACSF vehicle

relationships.subject: neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Female SNL rats (n = 6) had significantly upregulated CGRP expression in the CeA compared to sham

relationships.subject: parabrachial nucleus
relationships.evidence_quote: the parabrachial nucleus is the exclusive source of CGRP to the CeA

key_findings: CeA CGRP mRNA rose acutely in male SNL rats but chronically in female SNL rats (with CLR and Ramp1)
CGRP 8-37 in CeA reduced mechanical hypersensitivity in both sexes but affected vocalizations and anxiety-like behavior only in females
